claim: Choose an English RVC configuration with a higher calibrated speaker-embedding similarity to attributable Brad Pitt reference speech, without worse transcription. This is not a perceptual identity guarantee.

prompts.tuning: I used to think that every important decision had to happen in a hurry. Sometimes that works. Sometimes it just means you arrive in the wrong place a little faster.
prompts.heldout: I stopped at a small diner beside the highway and ordered coffee. The man behind the counter asked where I was going. I told him I wasn't sure yet.

hypotheses: The source voice determines prosody and pitch. A conversational source may fit the target speaker better than a narration source.
RVC explicitly shifts the source F0. Matching the target pitch range may improve speaker similarity.
Higher index blending replaces more source features with training-speaker features, but may degrade words.
Interpolating unvoiced F0 removes the distinction that consonant protection uses. Preserve it only if an actual comparison improves the result.
